 Rockets kickoff 2026-2027 NBA season with matchup with Mavs
 The Rockets start their season tonight!
 by Darren Yuvan Oct 21, 2026, 11:30 PM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 Houston Rockets vs. Dallas Mavericks
 October 21, 2026 
 Location: Toyota Center, Houston, TX
 Time : 7:30 PM CST
 TV :Space City Home Network
 Radio :KBME Sports Talk 790 / KLTN 102.9 (en español)
 Probable Starters
 Rockets : Fred Vanvleet, Amen Thompson, Jabari Smith Jr., Kevin Durant, Alperen Sengun
 Mavericks: Kyrie Irving, Zaccharie Risacher, Cooper Flag, P.J. Washington Jr., Daniel Gafford
 The Rockets are kicking off the new season tonight! Join us at TDS or on the SB Nation app to talk game all night.
